description: Source code implementing the DynamicSection class for ELF dynamic section parsing and handling, including initialization, symbol lookup, and constructor/destructor invocation.

classes.name: DynamicSection
classes.description: Class managing ELF dynamic section entries, symbol resolution, and lifecycle functions.

methods.name: InitDynamicSection
methods.description: Initializes the dynamic section by parsing tags and setting internal pointers and flags.

methods.name: GetDynamicTable
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the dynamic table array.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the dynamic table.

methods.name: CallConstructors
methods.description: Invokes initialization functions specified in the dynamic section.

methods.name: CallDestructors
methods.description: Invokes finalization functions specified in the dynamic section.

methods.name: CallFunction
methods.description: Calls a function pointer if it is valid (non-zero, not -1).

methods.name: LookupById
methods.description: Retrieves symbol information by index from the symbol table.

methods.name: IsWeakById
methods.description: Checks if a symbol by index is a weak symbol.

methods.name: LookupNameById
methods.description: Gets the symbol name by index.

methods.name: LookupByName
methods.description: Finds a symbol by its name using hash tables.
